summary: NFT Limited, a Cayman-incorporated Hong Kong-based crypto/NFT platform registrant, filed a Form 6-K reporting a September 30, 2026 Regulation S private placement. The company agreed to sell 80,000,000 Class A ordinary shares at $0.45 per share, an aggregate purchase price of approximately $36 million, to non-U.S. purchasers. Net proceeds fund the NFT artwork trading platform, a planned AI robotics project, working capital, and general corporate purposes. Closing conditions include NYSE American approval of the supplemental listing application and accuracy of representations and warranties. The SPA includes Exhibit 99.1, with customary covenants; CEO Yanying Wang signed.
